name: netrunner-crew
description: Netrunner crew: walking hacker crabs for your running subagents, a one-line crew row above the prompt (it joins the Netrunner WAITING line), a progress bar for /savvy-flow, and an agents panel (/crew). A fork of savvy-progress by johnnyvizz (MIT).

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: savvy: when a savvy-flow worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts; off: never opens by itself (the progress bar above the prompt still shows, and /crew opens the panel)

finished.title: Finished agents
finished.description: show: list finished agents under the running ones; hide: list only agents that are still running
